snippet.title: Battleplan | Announcement Trailer - Defence
snippet.description:
Step into the shoes of an Allied commander in Battleplan - the first wargame that lets you draw your own strategy directly on authentic WWII maps.
Lead your forces across 11 historical missions of the D-Day campaign, from Cherbourg and Caen to the Battle of the Bulge and the final push into Germany.
Every map is based on real wartime terrain, featuring archival photographs placed exactly where they were taken.

🎮 Wishlist now on Steam ➡️ https://store.steampowered.com/app/3743140/Battleplan/
💬 Join the Discord Server ➡️ https://discord.gg/rFSRzjEjc6
🦎 More info on Slitherine ➡️ https://www.slitherine.com/game/battleplan
